web-root: <WEB_ROOT: repo-relative root of the Angular web project, forward slashes — e.g. AuditTrakker.Web/src/app/code-trakker>
routing-module: <ROUTING_MODULE: repo-relative path to the routing module the test-host route is added to, forward slashes — e.g. AuditTrakker.Web/src/app/code-trakker/code-trakker-routing.module.ts>
test-host-root: <TEST_HOST_ROOT: repo-relative root under which routed <kebab>-test/ host folders and the sandbox module-test component live, forward slashes — e.g. AuditTrakker.Web/src/app/code-trakker>
verify-command: <VERIFY_COMMAND: the shell command that typechecks/builds the stack so a scaffold can be verified before handoff — e.g. npx tsc -p AuditTrakker.Web/tsconfig.json --noEmit>
